item.title: 1968 Ford Mustang Convertible J-Code
item.description: This 1968 Ford Mustang convertible was initially delivered to Downey Ford in New Brunswick, Canada, and is said to have remained with the family of its original owner for approximately five decades and with one subsequent owner before being acquired by the seller in 2025. item.description: This 1971 Maserati Ghibli is one of 1,170 coupes manufactured over six years of production and is said to have been delivered new in Europe before being imported to Montreal, Quebec, in 1986. Chassis 1926 reportedly passed through two owners before being purchased in 2018 by its current owner, who commissioned an interior re-trim in beige leather, the replacement of the timing chain, and cleaning of the fuel tanks.
